title: CrUX top list
description: Origins of a Chrome UX Report list up to a rank bucket, globally or for one country, from zakird/crux-top-lists (the default, up to rank 1M) or lonetis/crux-cache (every origin CrUX tracks). `latest` is resolved to a concrete month before the first analysis is published.

source.description: Where the list comes from: `crux-top-lists` (zakird/crux-top-lists: rank buckets up to 1000000, country lists from 202501) or `crux-cache` (lonetis/crux-cache: every origin and bucket, the countries it publishes).

country.description: `global` or a lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (crux-top-lists has country lists from 202501, crux-cache only the countries it publishes).

bucket.description: Include origins with rank bucket ≤ this value (the cap of the scan); buckets above 1000000 need source crux-cache.

origin.description: Origin as listed (scheme + host, no trailing slash; http and https occur).

rank.description: CrUX rank bucket of the origin.
